summary: An election night entry ends with the writer going home early, cold and tired.
realLife: After collecting the returns at the newspaper offices, Strong went home early because he was cold and tired.
sources: Emerging Civil War, Strong's election-day diary entries 1840 to 1872: https://emergingcivilwar.com/2020/11/03/this-momentous-day-presidential-elections-process-in-19th-century-nyc/
inGame: The `ahead` move of the first evening, and the end of an election-night entry (`event:election-result`).
